entries.proposition: System: C57BL/6 neonatal mice at postnatal day 10 with unilateral carotid ligation and one hour at 8 percent oxygen, with or without a prior LPS injection; the hypoxia is the injury and no oxygen therapy is given or compared. No WWOX.
entries.snippet: HI injury was modeled in postnatal day (p) 10 mice with permanent unilateral left carotid artery ligation followed by 1 hour of recovery and then 1 hour of hypoxia at FiO2 = 0.08

entries.proposition: Group sizes in the Methods and the Abstract: 10 inflammation-sensitised and 12 hypoxia-ischaemia-alone mice for EEG.
entries.snippet: n = 10 [5 female, 5 male] for IS-HI, n = 12 [5 female, 7 male] for HI alone, n = 4 [1 female, 3 male] for sham, n = 6 [3 female, 3 male] for LPS only

entries.proposition: Deaths: three of the inflammation-sensitised mice died during hypoxia after a convulsive seizure and none in the hypoxia-alone group; the mortality difference is not analysed.
entries.snippet: Mortalities of mice included in this analysis include n = 3 [1 female, 2 males] in the IS-HI group, all during hypoxia following a convulsive seizure, and n = 0 in the HI only group.

entries.proposition: Acute seizure result: no difference in seizure duration (63 versus 62 seconds, p 0.57), burden or median behavioural score (5 versus 6, p 0.25 on an unpaired t-test of an ordinal score).
entries.snippet: There was no significant difference in median BSS between the IS-HI group and HI group, respectively 5 and 6 (p = 0.25, unpaired t-test).

entries.proposition: Seizures began about 16 seconds into hypoxia on average, and nonconvulsive seizures occurred only during hypoxia and reoxygenation.
entries.snippet: Seizures began on average 16 ± 24 seconds following the start of hypoxia in the HI and IS-HI groups combined.

entries.proposition: EEG background: the inflammation-sensitised group appears to recover more slowly; the difference at the first hypoxia time point is reported as p = 0.05 and called not significant.
entries.snippet: hypoxia 1 p = 0.05, hypoxia 2 p = 0.18, reoxygenation 1 p = 0.42, reoxygenation 2 p = 0.51, unpaired t-test

entries.proposition: Histology result: total neuropathology score about 8 for hypoxia-ischaemia alone and about 23 with LPS (maximum 60 per animal), p below 0.0001; scoring is on DAPI-stained sections only.
entries.snippet: The mice in the IS-HI group had significantly higher total neuropathologic severity scores compared to the HI only group

entries.proposition: The unit of analysis for the p-values (animal or brain slice) is not stated although five slices per animal were scored.
entries.snippet: Each slice was scored for lesion size and tissue damage by a researcher (W.M.) blinded to treatment group and sex

entries.proposition: EEG and histology came from different animals, so seizure burden and lesion size cannot be related within an animal.
entries.snippet: histology could not be done on the same animals used for EEG due to permanent headset implantation

entries.proposition: The Discussion concludes that acute seizures do not contribute to the greater injury, from equal seizure duration among survivors, although three sensitised mice died during hypoxia.
entries.snippet: This indicates that acute seizures do not contribute to the increased severity of injury in IS-HI compared to HI, which has been previously published and demonstrated here.

entries.proposition: Supplementary data files: the three deposited spreadsheets labelled seizure review, background EEG review and neuropathologic scores are byte-identical (same SHA-256) and contain only the per-seizure event table with sheets named HI and LPS.
entries.snippet: Seizure #	Start time	Stop time 	Time (s) 	Phase	Only electrographic? (1 = Y, 0 = N)	BSS
entries.anchor: Supplementary files S1 to S3 (identical workbook)

entries.proposition: Figures 1 to 3: design with LPS 4 h before ligation then 8 percent oxygen for 1 h and 21 percent for 30 min (32 mice for video EEG, 20 for histology); EEG patterns (baseline, global suppression, burst suppression, seizure); seizure score plots for the two groups (the legend labels the hypoxia-alone group n = 10 and the sensitised group n = 12, the reverse of the Methods); background-activity curves reaching about 35 percent of baseline (hypoxia alone) against about 48 percent (sensitised) mid-hypoxia without error bars; seizure-time bars equal.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 A-B design; Figure 2 A-D EEG traces; Figure 3 A-D BSS timing, background activity, seizure time.

entries.proposition: Figures 4 and 5 and Table 1: lesion-score bars (total about 8 against about 23; cortex about 0.5 against 1.5; thalamus about 0.8 against 2.1; hippocampus about 0.9 against 1.9, **** each); DAPI whole-section images with a large ipsilateral cavity in the sensitised example; the 0 to 4 scale per region.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4 A-D bars; Figure 5 A-D DAPI sections; Table 1 scoring scale rows 0 to 4.
